integrations.label: NuvioTV
integrations.setup_action: Create an observation client and configure the Nuvio Fasti provider.
integrations.detail: Authenticated occurrence ingress is mounted. Nuvio must keep its own durable retry outbox.

integrations.label: Plex
integrations.setup_action: Use Tautulli, or place the Plex webhook behind a trusted proxy that injects a scoped Fasti Authorization header.
integrations.detail: Plex webhooks do not carry a Fasti credential. Fasti never places authorization secrets in webhook URLs.

integrations.label: Tautulli
integrations.setup_action: Configure the documented JSON template and Authorization header.
integrations.detail: Tautulli can submit watched events through a bounded authenticated webhook.

integrations.label: Jellyfin
integrations.setup_action: Configure the Jellyfin Webhook plugin with the Fasti template and Authorization header.
integrations.detail: Completed playback notifications are normalized into durable Fasti occurrences.

integrations.label: Emby
integrations.setup_action: Configure Emby playback-stop/mark-played webhooks with a scoped Authorization header.
integrations.detail: Native Emby event payloads are accepted only when completion is explicit.

integrations.label: Desktop MPRIS observer
integrations.detail: MPRIS support is platform-scoped and never claimed on unsupported operating systems.
